text: ok and then i do not see the paintings selection in the piece focus, though u could argue its literally made along side when you were just editing it, so technically didnt exist at that point. [Image #3] [Image #4] like this option here, could you add it to the focus panel
resolution: Added the PAINTINGS wardrobe to the PIECE FOCUS panel: selecting a placed authored piece whose model stores paintings now shows one chip per stored look plus Current (base atlas), with the worn look highlighted — the exact wardrobe the right-click quick menu carries (req_3443), running the same undoable world.piece.skin transaction. Per the req_3449 stale-closure law each chip bakes only its skinId (its identity); the target piece and the already-worn check resolve from live state at click time in AppFrame, so chips stay correct across selection changes. The section renders only when paintings exist (req_3444 density rule — no empty section), and only on instances since skins dress the placed piece, not the palette definition. Cart bundles clean via esbuild; hot-reloadable .tsx only.
